note: One canonical spelling per error meaning. Aliases listed here must not appear in module specs, tests or the OpenAPI document. Chosen by prevailing usage on 2026-10-22 (CR-ERR-01).

canonical.IDEMPOTENCY_CONFLICT: Same Idempotency-Key reused with a different request body (409).
canonical.IDEMPOTENCY_IN_PROGRESS: Same Idempotency-Key whose first request is still running (409).
canonical.SELF_APPROVAL_DENIED: Maker attempted to approve their own submission (403).
canonical.VERSION_CONFLICT: If-Match did not match the current version (409).
canonical.SCOPE_DENIED: The actor lacks the tenant, unit, project or contract scope (403).
canonical.STAGE_TRANSITION_DENIED: The state transition is not allowed from the current state (409).
canonical.REVIEW_INVALID: A theme review is expired, used, foreign or based on a stale draft (409); REVIEW_STALE was dropped.

excluded.IN_PROGRESS: Not a code: shorthand for IDEMPOTENCY_IN_PROGRESS in a UAT row (ADM.md UAT-AC131); also a state name. Use the canonical code.
excluded.ACK_REQUIRED: Not a code: shorthand for AVC_WARNING_ACK_REQUIRED in AC-CAP-06 (CAP.md). Use the registered code.
excluded.WINDOW_CLOSED: Not a code: shorthand for CHANNEL_WINDOW_CLOSED in a UAT row (OMNI.md UAT-AC195). Use the registered code.
excluded.REVIEW_TOKEN_INVALID: Not a code: retired spelling in a test case; the single theme-review code is REVIEW_INVALID (SAS.md BR-SAS-17).
